subject: Quick: Exec meeting overlap — compress Friday walkthrough?
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Veridata Tech - PM <pm@veridatatech.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Hi Grace,

Heads up — our VP of Product has an executive offsite that just landed on Friday morning and several of the cross-functional stakeholders who were going to attend the full demo are now double-booked.

We still want to see Redwood in action this week if possible, but we have two constraints: 1) we need at least one short executive-level summary for the VP (15–20m), and 2) product + infra need the deep walk (40–50m) but can't be earlier than 2pm CET on Friday.

Any chance you can compress and split the session into two back-to-back blocks (exec summary + technical deep-dive) or move the deep-dive to next Monday?

Attaching the stakeholder availability we have so far.

Thanks — Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Solutions, Veridata Tech
liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com
+44 20 7946 0991
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Thanks for the heads up, Liam — appreciate the quick update.

We can definitely accommodate this. Two possible approaches:

- Option A (same day, compressed): 20m exec overview (Grace) + 45m technical deep-dive (Karthik) back-to-back at 14:00 CET. We'll compress some demo narrative but keep the key performance/cost ops callouts. Marissa can cover procurement/next steps in the last 5 mins.

- Option B (split): 20m exec summary Friday at 10:30 CET and full technical deep-dive Monday at 14:00 CET. This gives the product/infra team more headroom.

I've pulled a quick agenda and two proposed slot files — attaching agenda_v2.pdf and proposed_slots.ics. Which option should we lock? If you want Option A, I'll send updated calendar invites now. If Option B, I'll hold the deep-dive slot and send separate invites.

Quick note: Karthik will be traveling Friday morning but confirmed he can join from the road for a 14:00 CET start; he prefers to avoid being the primary for the exec summary if possible.

Best,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Veridata Tech - PM <pm@veridatatech.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:20:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Grace — thanks, both options sound reasonable. Small points from our side:

- Exec summary needs to include one slide on run/ops cost expectations and one short comparison to our current infra stack (we'll drop a note to Marissa with the numbers).
- For Option A, can Karthik lead the deep-dive even if joining remotely? He has the technical context and that's the priority.
- For Option B, Monday 14:00 CET works.

If it's not a blocker for you, we'd prefer Option B so the team can digest the exec summary separately and come prepared with deeper questions on Monday. But if your calendar is tight next week, Option A is fine.

I'll check with the VP and confirm in a few hours.

Cheers,
Liam
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Quick note from my side: I can own the deep-dive Monday 14:00 CET (will be back in a proper connection by then). If we do Option A on Friday, I can still present remotely for the deep-dive at 14:00 CET — I may be on a train at the start but will have my laptop and hotspot and can share slides/demos. Either works for me.

If we go Option B, Grace — can you run the exec summary on Friday? I can provide the two cost slides and a one-paragraph comparison for your deck by EOD.

Also flagged: Marissa, if you're available Monday we should confirm procurement/term questions during the deep-dive (5–10m) so Liam's team has a clear next step to accept/approve.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Liam — thanks for the detail and for checking with your VP. If you're leaning toward Option B, let's lock that:

- Exec summary: Friday 10:30 CET — 20m. Lead: Grace. Deck: agenda_v2.pdf (I added the cost slide placeholder).
- Full technical deep-dive: Monday 14:00 CET — 50m. Lead: Karthik. Procurement/next steps: Marissa (last 7 mins).

I'll send the two calendar invites now and include the agenda and the HubSpot demo record (link below). If anything changes on your side, we can still collapse Option A on short notice but Monday gives everyone breathing room.

Sending invites.

Best,
Grace
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@veridatatech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Veridata Tech - PM <pm@veridatatech.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Friday walkthrough — conflict on exec side

Grace — confirmed with the VP: Option B preferred. Thanks for being flexible and for the quick turnaround on the agenda. Calendar received and invites accepted.

I'll share a very short pre-read for execs (one slide) by EOD Thursday so you can paste it into the Friday 10:30 deck. Looking forward to Monday's deep-dive.

Appreciate it — Liam

--
Liam O'Connor
Head of Solutions, Veridata Tech
(calendar invites created)
- Friday 2027-06-04 10:30 CET — Redwood exec summary (20m) — organizer: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
- Monday 2027-06-07 14:00 CET — Redwood technical deep-dive (50m) — organizer: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: agenda_v2.pdf (2 pages), proposed_slots.ics (calendar options)
